subject: Amplify Labs pilot: buyer authorization windows & billing cadence
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@amplifylabs.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot procurement and PO details

Sean — thanks again for the demo yesterday. Amplify is excited to move forward with a 90-day pilot but we need clarity on two operational points before we sign a private offer: 

1) Buyer sign-off windows: our procurement org needs to know how long they have to accept the private offer once the marketplace PO is sent (we have multiple approvers across Billing and Security). Is there a typical expiry or activation window you recommend?

2) Billing cadence and proration: if we start mid-month, how will activation/proration show on our invoice and the AWS billing for reserved capacity?

Also, security wants a short evidence pack (SOC2 summary, data flow diagram for private deployments). Can you send that as an attachment or point me to a secure link?

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Lee
Head of Platform Ops, Amplify Labs
jordan.lee@amplifylabs.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@amplifylabs.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot procurement and PO details

Jordan — great to hear. Quick answers up front, and copying Neha (commercial ops) and Vanessa (marketplace lead) for the contract path: 

• Buyer sign-off window: we typically set a 30-calendar-day acceptance window on the AWS private offer. If you need longer (45–60 days) we can request an extended activation window on the PO; it's allowed but requires a seller-side justification.

• Billing cadence & proration: activation is tied to the private offer activation date. AWS charges based on activation month; for mid-month starts we can configure proration in the private-offer metadata and reflect it on the invoice. For pilots we usually recommend invoicing at the end of the pilot to simplify accounting.

I can attach a short evidence pack and a PO term matrix — looping Neha to prepare the attachments and decide whether we should request a 45-day acceptance window up-front given Amplify's multi-approver flow.

Next step: Neha, can you prepare the evidence PDF and a PO term matrix that shows 30/45/60-day activation options and the billing implications (proration example)? Vanessa — any red flags on seller-side approval if we request 45 days?

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T12:14:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Amplify evidence & PO term matrix (draft)

Forwarding draft pack for review before sending to Amplify. Attachments: amplify-evidence-pack.pdf (SOC2 summary + network diagram) and po-term-matrix.xlsx (30/45/60 day columns + proration examples).

Internal notes: if we push for 45-day acceptance we'll need approval from Marketplace Pricing (to justify longer seller-side hold) and Finance (billing treatment). Vanessa — recommend we do 45 days for this pilot because Jordan mentioned cross-functional approvers which usually takes ~3 weeks. If okay, I'll route an approval request to Pricing + Finance with rationale and the HubSpot deal link.

Preview of key lines in the PO term matrix (for internal review):
- 30-day acceptance: standard, auto-activation on seller trigger; proration as per AWS monthly cycle.
- 45-day acceptance: extended window; seller must flag 'extended_activation' on the PO; Finance requires non-standard flag and copies to billing ops.
- 60-day acceptance: exceptional; escalates to Director-level approval and may require credit hold.

Sean — once approved I'll send the two attachments to Jordan and include the HubSpot link + a DocuSign draft if they ask for signature.

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Amplify evidence & PO term matrix (draft)

Neha — sounds good. I don't foresee Pricing blocking a 45-day activation for a pilot under $50k ARR, but Finance will want to see the proration examples and the rationale (multi-approver timeline). I'll approve routing to Pricing + Finance; please include a short impact note for Finance summarizing potential invoice timing and any deferred revenue timing risk.

One more operational note for the AMPLIFY onboarding team: if we set 45 days, include a line that we will re-send the private offer 7 days before expiry as a reminder. That reduces buyer drop-off.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Marketplace Program Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@amplifylabs.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-21T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot procurement and PO details

Thanks — this helps a lot. 45 days would be ideal on our side. Two quick asks before we proceed: 
1) Please send the evidence pack and the PO term matrix to my security and procurement aliases (security@amplifylabs.com, procurement@amplifylabs.com).
2) Can you add a clause to the private offer metadata that the seller will send a reminder 7 days before expiry (as Vanessa suggested)?

If you send the attachments and the updated PO metadata I'll share with our approvers and track the workflow. Looking forward to getting the pilot on the books.

—Jordan
Jordan Lee
Head of Platform Ops, Amplify Labs
